pkgmetadata.longdescription: scikit-allel provides array-based data structures and statistics for genetic variation data (VCF, Zarr, HDF5). Packaged here as the runtime dependency that ancIBD uses to read VCFs into its HDF5 format. Installing dev-python/dask (from the ::stuff overlay) additionally enables the dask-backed chunked array classes; allel guards that import, so it is optional.
